company.name: Alberto Watch Company
company.address: 418 Madison Avenue, New York, NY 10017, USA
about: Alberto Watch Company began in 1968 as a two-bench repair shop run by master watchmaker Alberto Russo. Today we are a full-service watch repair, appraisal and retail house offering one of the finest selections of luxury timepieces in the city.

Our certified watchmakers service everything from 19th-century pocket watches to the latest smart watches. Every repair is pressure-tested, timed on a chronocomparator and returned with a 24-month workmanship warranty.
We also carry a wide selection of brand-new watches from Rolex, Michael Kors, Citizen Eco-Drive, Bulova and more — each backed by the manufacturer's warranty and our own after-sales care.

technology.title: Mechanical movements
technology.body: A wound mainspring releases energy through a gear train, regulated by a balance wheel oscillating up to 28,800 times per hour. No battery — just springs, wheels and centuries of craft.

technology.title: Automatic winding
technology.body: A weighted rotor spins with the movement of your wrist and winds the mainspring for you. Most modern automatics store 40–80 hours of power.

technology.title: Quartz accuracy
technology.body: A quartz crystal vibrates 32,768 times per second when electrified. A chip counts those vibrations to drive the hands — accurate to about ±15 seconds a month.

technology.title: Eco-Drive & solar
technology.body: Light-powered watches such as Citizen Eco-Drive convert any light source into energy and store it in a rechargeable cell — months of power from a single charge.

technology.title: Smart sensors
technology.body: Optical heart-rate sensors, ECG electrodes, GPS, accelerometers and gyroscopes turn a smart watch into a health and navigation tool that syncs with your phone.

technology.title: Water resistance
technology.body: Screw-down crowns, gaskets and thick case-backs keep water out. Ratings are tested in our workshop with a pressure tester before every repaired watch leaves us.

faq.q: How long does a full service take?
faq.a: Most mechanical services take 3–5 weeks. Vintage pieces that need parts made by hand can take longer — we always give you a written estimate first.

faq.q: Are your new watches covered by the manufacturer's warranty?
faq.a: Yes. Every new watch is sold with the full manufacturer warranty plus our own 12-month in-store care plan.

faq.q: Do you buy or trade-in pre-owned watches?
faq.a: Yes. Bring your watch to any showroom for a free evaluation. Trade-in credit can be applied to any purchase.
We replace batteries, screens and straps for most major smart-watch brands at our Los Angeles and New York workshops.
We ship insured worldwide. Duties and taxes are calculated at checkout or quoted by our concierge team.
